texts.preamble: Fir No. 74-13 Crime Branch State vs . Bhagwati Kumar U/S 188 Ipc & 59(1) ... on 23 September, 2015 Fir No. 74-13 Crime Branch State Vs. Bhagwati Kumar U/s 188 Ipc & 59(1) F.S.S. Act, 2006 In The Court Of Pooran Chand: Chief Metropolitan Magistrate: Central District: Tis Hazari Courts: Delhi Fir No. 74/13 Ps: Crime Branch State Vs. Bhagwati Kumar U/s 59(1) of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 & 188 Ipc Unique Id No.: 0240Ir0197802014 J U D G M E N T:
texts.facts: 1. The brief facts leading to the present case are that on 22.04.2013, an information was received by HC Deepak Kumar through informer that a person namely Sanjay Fir No. 74-13 Crime Branch State vs . Bhagwati Kumar U/S 188 Ipc & 59(1) ... on 23 September, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49341744/ 1 who will get the Gutkha load from a train at New Delhi Railway Station platform no.3. On the basis of information, a trap was laid at platform no.3, South Side of parcel godown Minto bridge New Delhi. One person namely Sanjay Kumar s/o Udesh Singh aged 29 years was apprehended who was found 24 cartons of Gutkha containing tobacco mark as 'PADAM SHRI'. On interrogation, Sanjay Kumar disclosed that he was worker of one Bhagwati Kumar. Thereafter, accused Bhagwati Kumar was apprehended who confessed that he procures this gutkha from Hubli Karnataka and sends the same for sale in different states in India. Thereafter, on the basis of complaint, present FIR was registered. 2. After the investigation, charge sheet was filed in the present case and cognizance for offence was taken. 3. Thereafter, present accused persons were summoned. 23.09.2015 chargesheet was supplied to the accused persons in compliance of section 207 Cr.P.C and matter was kept for consideration on charge. 4. Today, argument on point of charge heard and charge u/s 59(1) of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 & 188 IPC was framed against the accused persons to which they pleaded guilty. The Court has warned the accused persons regarding consequences of pleading guilty. However, both the accused persons insisted that they are pleading guilty without any fear and coercion and they are understanding the consequences of the plea of guilt.
texts.arguments: It is further submitted that he is a labourer and was acting on behalf of main convict Bhagwati Kumar and as such lenient view may be taken. It is submitted on behalf of convict Bhagwati Kumar is 44 years old.
